name: Tonemapping and Gamma Correction
aliases: Exposure and Gamma Correction, Final image processing
definition: Final image processing including exposure, luminance-based desaturation, and gamma correction.
summary: Tonemapping and Gamma Correction converts HDR radiance to sRGB using exponential compression, chroma preservation, and black point correction, differing from ACES by using simpler steps rather than a single parametric curve.
